name: facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/core/bbox/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.build_assigner: build a bounding box assigner from a config dict using the BBOX_ASSIGNERS registry
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.build_sampler: build a bounding box sampler from a config dict using the BBOX_SAMPLERS registry

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.review_random_boxes_function: review the random_boxes function that generates bounding box tensors with configurable scale
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.test_ensure_rng_function: test the ensure_rng function that normalizes seed inputs to a RandomState

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.flip_bboxes: flip bounding boxes horizontally, vertically, or diagonally given an image shape tensor
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.map_bboxes_to_test_scale: map bounding boxes from original image scale to testing scale with optional flip
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.convert_bboxes_to_roi: convert a list of bounding box tensors to ROI format with batch indices
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.decode_distance_to_bbox: decode distance predictions from anchor points into bounding box coordinates
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/mmdet/.convert_bbox_coordinate_formats: convert bounding box coordinates between xyxy and cxcywh formats
